whenToUse: Numbers with a fixed format, such as phone, card, or business registration numbers.
Long numbers are less error-prone when split into groups.
Pasted numbers come in all sorts of formats.
whenNotToUse: International phone numbers whose format varies by country (use with a country picker).
Free text without a format, such as names or addresses.
Long text where a jumping cursor would get in the way.

alternatives.name: OTP Input
alternatives.reason: Short codes taken box by box.

accessibility: Say in the label what to enter, and show a format example in the placeholder and hint.
Match the keypad and autofill with inputmode="numeric" and autocomplete (tel, cc-number).
Even when separators are inserted, the cursor stays after the digit just typed so people can keep going.
Deleting a separator recalculates from the digits, so Backspace never gets stuck.
